source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of debugging and testing (PDF 26).

blocks.text: Software debugging aur testing software development ke bohat aham marahil (stages) hain jo software product ki quality aur reliability (bharosa) yaqeeni banate hain. Achi debugging aur testing se developers tasdeeq kar sakte hain ke software zaroori specifications poori karta hai, irade ke mutabiq kaam karta hai aur us mein koi sangeen (critical) ghalti nahi.

blocks.prompt: Debugging aur testing software ke bare mein kya tasdeeq karti hain?
blocks.explanation: Ke software zaroori specifications poori karta hai, irade ke mutabiq kaam karta hai aur sangeen errors se paak hai.

items: Debugging aur testing: quality aur reliability yaqeeni banane wale aham marahil.
